# Validation Coverage Checklist: Dynamic Survey Viewer

**Purpose**: Validate that the validation requirements are complete and unambiguous — that every rule the
contract admits is enforced at both boundaries Principle III names, that every rule has stated error text,
and that no rule is enforced only at the control.
**Created**: 2026-10-08
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · [contracts/survey-json.md](../contracts/survey-json.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

**Author's review pass**: items CHK004, CHK005 and CHK007 failed on 2026-10-08 and are fixed in the
current revision of `spec.md` — see [Checklist review](../spec.md#checklist-review--session-2026-10-08).

## Rule coverage — is every contract rule validated?

- [ ] CHK001 Is a validation rule stated for every constraint the contract admits (`required`, `minLength`, `maxLength`, `minSelections`, `maxSelections`, `scale`), with none left to the control alone? [Coverage, Contract §2]
- [ ] CHK002 Is required-ness defined separately for each of the six types, rather than assumed uniform? [Completeness, Spec §FR-012]
- [ ] CHK003 Is the interaction between `required` and `minSelections` resolved into a single effective minimum? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016]
- [ ] CHK004 Can every error string an acceptance scenario asserts be derived from the requirements and the config, with no scenario asserting wording the contract cannot produce? [Conflict, Spec §FR-019] — **failed: User Story 2 scenario 2 asserted per-question wording with no source; fixed by FR-069**
- [ ] CHK005 Does an error message exist for every rule, including `maxLength`, `maxSelections` and an out-of-range `rating` on a non-default scale? [Gap, Spec §FR-019] — **failed; fixed by the FR-069 catalogue**
- [ ] CHK006 Is the pluralisation of a message's quantity specified, so "1 option" and "3 options" are both decided? [Clarity, Spec §FR-069]
- [ ] CHK007 Is each upper-bound rule enforced at validation as well as at the control, so a value arriving by another route still fails closed? [Gap, Spec §FR-015, §FR-017] — **failed: `maxSelections` was control-only; fixed by FR-070**

## Both boundaries — Principle III

- [ ] CHK008 Is it stated that the current page is validated before forward navigation and that every page is validated again before a submission starts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-011]
- [ ] CHK009 Is it stated that Previous is never gated by validation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-031]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the behaviour of a Submit blocked by an invalid earlier page specified, including which page renders and where focus lands? [Coverage, Spec §FR-034]
- [ ] CHK011 Is it stated that a blocked Submit makes no call across the submission boundary at all? [Completeness, Contract §1]
- [ ] CHK012 Are attachments required to be re-checked immediately before a submission, and is the failure surfaced on the owning question's page? [Coverage, Spec §FR-027]
- [ ] CHK013 Is a blocked Submit's effect on the `clientSubmissionId` specified? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-061]

## Clarity of the rules themselves

- [ ] CHK014 Is the unit of text length specified, so an emoji and a combining sequence have a decided length? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK015 Is trimming specified as happening before every length comparison, including the required check? [Clarity, Spec §FR-013]
- [ ] CHK016 Is the precedence between the required rule and `minLength` decided for an empty answer, so one omission yields one error? [Clarity, Spec §FR-014]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the order in which a file's checks run specified, so the message for a file failing two checks is determined? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]
- [ ] CHK018 Is duplicate-file identity defined by stated fields rather than left to interpretation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-023]

## Scenario & Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK019 Is at least one invalid input specified for each of the six types, as SC-003 claims? [Coverage, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Are requirements stated for an optional question left empty and for an optional question answered badly, as distinct outcomes? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK021 Is the behaviour of a page with zero questions decided? [Edge Case, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK022 Is the state of a page the respondent returns to decided — answers kept, errors dropped — rather than left to the implementer? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-064]
- [ ] CHK023 Is error clearing on change specified as per-question and immediate? [Clarity, Spec §FR-020]
- [ ] CHK024 Are requirements stated for a page with several invalid questions, covering both the per-question text and the page summary order? [Coverage, Spec §FR-030]
- [ ] CHK025 Is clearing an answered required `rating` or `satisfaction` decided, including what it reports at the next Next? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-060]

## Notes

- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Items annotated **failed** record what the author's own pass found and where it was fixed
